stage: raw expected comparison cases; independent checker must review before value decision

vectors.trigger: Empty partial save draft has country absent and street/notes pending edits.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: No region lookup or final save. Child unavailable/empty; unrelated drafts retained. This absent prerequisite state is not a complete canonical submission.

vectors.trigger: Typed current readable country=alpha, lookup succeeds with north/south.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Child choices only granted active Region refs belonging alpha; label names are display only. Selection passed as actual ref; no copied input schema or raw ID cast.

vectors.trigger: country alpha->beta after region=north selected while notes edited.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Clear incompatible north immediately, invalidate alpha request; beta choices include west. Keep notes/street; save with alpha/north combination not silently copied into beta.

vectors.trigger: Lookup1(alpha) delayed; switch beta and Lookup2 succeeds [west]; canceled Lookup1 later returns [north,south].
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Late response discarded by owning form/context/sequence fence even if abort failed; beta/west not replaced. Cancellation alone cannot enforce correctness.

vectors.trigger: Same alpha/context lookup refresh includes selected north; reorder choices or rename north to another name unique within alpha.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Retain the actual still-eligible north reference; labels/order do not define identity. If the refreshed result excludes north, clear it while preserving unrelated drafts. Equal labels are separately exercised by approval A-02 using the original two Alex employee fixtures; do not create duplicate Region.name values within alpha.

vectors.trigger: Alpha active/current but all authorized Regions inactive or no Regions.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Truthful empty children and unavailable final selection. No all-country fallback, invisible retained child or false read failure.

vectors.trigger: Lookup transient failure versus denied parent grant versus malformed result.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Explicit distinguish read error from authorized empty. No leaked/cached cross-scope choices; repairable parent/notes remain, unsafe child unavailable until verified compatible result; no automatic save.

vectors.trigger: Change current Country.allowed removing caller or team membership while request is in flight; old response arrives; final save attempted.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Reject/withhold unauthorized candidates; context invalidates stale response. Final save rechecks membership/ref grants/current allowed relation and safely rejects; correctable street/notes retained.

vectors.trigger: Candidate north.parent moves alpha->beta or active false after selection but before save.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Current reference/version/relation/active check fails final save, with no Address created. Lookup selection is advisory, never ownership/eligibility authority.

vectors.trigger: Pass hidden/hidden_region foreign scope ref or Region from beta with country alpha using direct MCP/canonical envelope, without lookup.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Exact owning canonical inputs and current guards deny; no Address effects or disclosure. MCP can invoke valid save directly without browser draft dance but cannot bypass relation/membership.

vectors.trigger: Two /address form instances A/B each have a region lookup pending for alpha, with separate per-instance request identity. B retains alpha/north and unrelated typed draft fields. Change country in A to beta, cancel A's pending alpha lookup, then let both old A and still-pending B responses arrive.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Invalidate only A's child selection and retire/fence A's old lookup. A's change/cancellation must neither abort B's pending request nor mutate B's parent, child, unrelated draft, selection or focus. B's still-current successful response may retain eligible north only in B. Even if abort of A fails, its late response cannot populate either A or B; responses are scoped to their own form and current context.

vectors.trigger: Keyboard country selection -> loading -> region list -> empty/error; cancel modal/reconnect.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Accessible labels/announced changes and logical focus; related child invalidated without discarding notes/street; current authorized state reread on reconnect; no implicit save.

vectors.trigger: 101 authorized active Regions for selected country versus exactly100.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Supplementary source read rejects >100 explicitly rather than truncating as complete; <=100 may return bounded compatible result under owning work/query limits. Binding never invents a different max.

vectors.trigger: Valid save response lost; canonical saved-operation retry versus different changed payload under same operation identity.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Original saved Address returned once; changed same-ID payload conflict; no second creation. Lookup retry never executes save.

vectors.trigger: Original /documents reviewer_choices has document bound to current persisted Document row.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Do not claim it reads a partial sibling draft location. Current source already supplies authorized candidate list and candidate.user-bound canonical submit; proposed picker may reduce duplicated presentation only.

vectors.trigger: Candidates two Alex accounts, missing work name, descriptive work role Reviewer without actual approve.reviewer; caller/submitter.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Display disambiguating current readable name/user/role/home with opaque ref fallback; select actual user. Exclude caller/submitter; role text grants nothing.

vectors.trigger: Current scoped coordinator vs unrelated reviewer invokes choices; nonstaff null-scope submitter with empty authorized Employee work list.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Only permitted source query; work leaf grants applied. Truthful empty list does not narrow existing opaque user role-only null-scope admissions. Keep canonical unassisted input path; candidate lookup remains advice.

vectors.trigger: Document form instance switches from docA/siteA to docB/siteB; earlier choices response later arrives.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Invalidate incompatible selected user and old parent response; requery bound current persisted Document. Keep compatible correctable file/note/email/due according to canonical document context; do not label this as partial-sibling grammar.

vectors.trigger: Assignee loses actual reviewer role/team/site eligibility after picker result but before canonical submit or assign.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Current role/distinct-account/site/ref/version checks reject final action; candidate read did not grant authority. Preserve correctable unrelated fields. Coordinator recovery remains ordinary assign, never quorum/admission bypass.

vectors.trigger: Submit document stale envelope; reassign current Submission while old assignment modal open; old selected assignee retained.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Canonical current document/submission version conflict before effects. Refresh under current bound parent/grants; old selected candidate never authorizes stale write.

vectors.trigger: Choices read fails/unavailable, empty granted list, revoked Employee work fields or unreadable label home/name projection.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Error/empty/unreadable distinct; no authority-mode authentication directory/hidden-leaf display. Final opaque canonical assignee submission still follows original guards where its role-only scope permits.

vectors.trigger: Reassignment on pending exact submission versus approved/rejected/withdrawn; selection of submitter.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: ONE eligible distinct reviewer assigned; increment assignment/history/request and due replacement only when current pending revision. Finalized/self selections rejected under original implementation.

vectors.trigger: Change canonical from/until/quantity while availability pending; new response displayed then old read succeeds.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Current nested flow requires explicit matching check; any hypothetical custom advisory controller fences old response/price/terms. Minimal candidate-list binding does not convert scalar WorkspaceAvailability into choices.

vectors.trigger: available=true, another customer commits last capacity before hold; customer/company-booker grant revoked.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Hold rechecks canonical free/current customer/account/staff permissions; stale lookup reserves nothing and cannot authorize hold. Capacity failure creates no fabricated confirmed booking/payment/allowance.

vectors.trigger: Public availability result versus hidden customer records; desired amenities changed before hold.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Result remains published resource/price advice without customer data. Amenities is absent from hold inputs; no enforced amenity reservation promise or automatic benefit invented.

vectors.trigger: Binding target changed from canonical authorized read to submit/save/hold or arbitrary query/client JavaScript.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Future checker rejects mutation/arbitrary expression/extra backend before rendering or invocation; current alternative must use same existing canonical read routes.

vectors.trigger: Read parameter maps missing/wrong-type/unknown canonical input, optional prerequisite absent or ambient caller input captured.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Future checker rejects invalid mapping; absent legitimate typed parent prevents lookup only. No repeated copied schema, implicit authority context or synthetic default country/document.

vectors.trigger: Dependent child maps its own value into parent requirement or two children form dependency cycle.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Future checked graph rejects cycles; no infinite lookup/late response loop.

vectors.trigger: Evaluate static result type/bound incompatibility separately from current Employee.private_notes leaf grants. Do not treat private_notes as universally unreadable or HR membership as access to an unrelated approval read.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Future static checking rejects incompatible or unproved bounded result contracts. Current authorized leaf serving denies private_notes to an ordinary non-HR caller reading another employee through work-field grants; actual HR or authenticated own-row policy bodies grant that leaf on their scoped Employee read. These positive grant bodies do not add private labels to the proposed work-label sketch or authorize reviewer_choices independently.

subcases.trigger: Replace a required checked bounded Region[] result with an unbounded, malformed or scalar foreign contract, or use Employee.private_notes:text? as the value for assignee:user.
subcases.expected: Proposed checker rejects the static bound/type incompatibility; no cast, singleton workaround or silently global choices. No current implemented diagnostic is claimed.

subcases.trigger: An ordinary current member satisfying Employee work-read eligibility has no hr role and is not the other candidate row.user; request private_notes from that row.
subcases.expected: Current policy body at Employees.can:11 grants only listed work fields. No current leaf grant permits private_notes for this caller/row; authorized serving withholds or denies it without leakage. This is a dynamic caller/row grant case, separate from static result compatibility; runtime execution remains unmeasured.

subcases.trigger: Reference actual Employee read grant body for a current hr caller (Employees.can:10), or authenticated caller on row.user==actor (Employees.can:12).
subcases.expected: These bodies contain no fields restriction and therefore provide the private_notes leaf grant for the scoped Employee read. Revocation or loss of own-row scope removes the corresponding grant. This is source grant evidence only; it does not bypass reviewer_choices document/work requirements, return the excluded caller as a candidate, or change the proposed fixed work-label policy.

vectors.trigger: Consumer lacks capability/version for proposed checked metadata.
vectors.expected_all_equivalent_alternatives: Explicit compatibility failure rather than ignoring binding and exposing unfiltered child choices. Current sources remain diagnostics; sketch is not implemented artifact metadata.
